profile.name: TC200温度控制器
profile.description: Thorlabs TC200 是一款实验室温度控制器，用于驱动加热元件输出电压、读取热敏电阻温度，并通过 PID 调节将温度稳定在设定值。适用于样品加热、光学或机电实验中的温度稳定与热管理。
profile.description_en: The Thorlabs TC200 is a laboratory temperature controller that drives a heating element, reads temperature from a thermistor, and uses PID regulation to hold the temperature at a setpoint. It is used for sample heating, thermal stabilization, and temperature management in optical or electromechanical experiments.
